description: A private, token-gated OCI distribution surface for signed release artifacts. It serves content that an operator placed under a content-addressed root; it never builds, signs, deploys or executes an image.

surface.protocol: Docker Registry HTTP API v2, read-only subset
surface.binding: loopback only (127.0.0.1 / ::1); a private registry is not an overlay service
surface.auth: constant-time bearer token; the token file must be mode 0600 and at least 16 characters

storage.addressing: repository names, tags and digests are parsed by closed regular expressions; raw request paths are never joined to the root

endpoints: GET|HEAD /v2/<name>/blobs/<digest> — blob bytes, verified against the digest
rules: No token, no response: the auth check runs before path parsing, including for /v2/.
No push route, no build route and no deploy route: this is a distribution surface, not an image factory.
A manifest digest reference must match the manifest bytes; a blob digest must match the blob bytes.
An image digest named by a release is installed only by the explicit package operator action.
The registry carries executable content, so it is not a knowledge channel and never enters a vault, RFI answer or AI context.
Loopback plus bearer token is the boundary; enabling it on an overlay address is refused.
